meta.name: CTF Toolbox — Dork generator
meta.note: Genera solo query (nessuno scraping): apri il link nel motore scelto. Provider in config/dork/providers/ (un file per motore). Le stesse regole sono usate dalla pagina web e dalla CLI (./ctf dork).

presets.name: Documenti esposti (pdf/doc/xls/ppt)
presets.q: site:{t} (ext:pdf OR ext:doc OR ext:docx OR ext:xls OR ext:xlsx OR ext:ppt OR ext:pptx OR ext:odt)

presets.name: Config / .env / yml
presets.q: site:{t} (ext:env OR ext:ini OR ext:conf OR ext:cfg OR ext:yaml OR ext:yml)

presets.name: Dump / backup
presets.q: site:{t} (ext:sql OR ext:bak OR ext:backup OR ext:old OR ext:tar OR ext:gz OR ext:zip)

presets.name: Directory listing
presets.q: site:{t} intitle:"index of"

presets.name: Admin / login
presets.q: site:{t} (inurl:admin OR inurl:login OR inurl:signin OR inurl:dashboard OR intitle:admin)

presets.name: Parametri GET
presets.q: site:{t} inurl:? (inurl:redirect OR inurl:url= OR inurl:file= OR inurl:path= OR inurl:page=)

presets.name: Foothold (phpinfo / phpMyAdmin / server-status)
presets.q: site:{t} (inurl:phpinfo.php OR intitle:phpMyAdmin OR inurl:server-status OR intitle:"Apache2 Ubuntu Default Page")

presets.name: WordPress (config/backup/users)
presets.q: site:{t} (inurl:wp-config OR inurl:wp-content/backup OR inurl:wp-json/wp/v2/users OR inurl:xmlrpc.php)

presets.name: Segreti nel testo
presets.q: site:{t} ("api_key" OR "apikey" OR "secret" OR "token" OR "password" OR "BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY")

presets.name: Sottodomini
presets.q: site:*.{t} -www

presets.name: Errori / stack trace
presets.q: site:{t} ("SQL syntax" OR "Warning:" OR "Fatal error" OR "stack trace" OR "Traceback (most recent call last)")

presets.name: Cache / versioni passate
presets.q: cache:{t} OR site:webcache.googleusercontent.com {t}

presets.name: .git / .svn / .DS_Store / .env
presets.q: site:{t} (inurl:.git OR inurl:.svn OR inurl:.DS_Store OR inurl:.env)

presets.name: Segreti nel codice
presets.q: "{t}" (api_key OR apikey OR secret OR token OR password)

presets.name: Config/filename hardcoded
presets.q: "{t}" (filename:env OR filename:config OR filename:.env)

presets.name: Webcam / IoT
presets.q: site:{t} (inurl:viewerframe OR inurl:axis-cgi OR inurl:mjpg OR intitle:webcam)

presets.name: Pastebin / paste
presets.q: site:pastebin.com OR site:paste.ee OR site:rentry.co "{t}"

presets.name: Segreti menzionati fuori dal sito
presets.q: "{t}" (password OR secret OR token OR api_key) -site:{t}

presets.name: Host per hostname
presets.q: hostname:{t}

presets.name: Certificati (ssl/hostname)
presets.q: ssl.cert.subject.cn:"{t}"

presets.name: Per organizzazione
presets.q: org:"{t}"
